# Убить старые процессы pkill -9 -f 'port 18092' 2>/dev/null || true sleep 1 # Создать скрипт cat > /tmp/run_dashboard.py << 'SCRIPT' import json from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler): def do_GET(self): try: with open('/opt/trading-bot/classic/runs.json') as f: runs = json.load(f) except: runs = [] html = '

📊 Прогоны

' for r in runs: t = r.get('trades', []) profit = sum(x.get('net', 0) for x in t) win = sum(1 for x in t if x.get('net', 0) > 0) cls = 'profit' if profit > 0 else 'loss' if profit < 0 else 'neutral' html += f'

{r["name"]}

{r["sym"]} {r["cfg"].get("tf","?")}

Сделок:{len(t)}
Побед:{win}
Результат:{profit:+.1f}%
' html += '
' self.send_response(200) self.send_header('Content-type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8') self.end_headers() self.wfile.write(html.encode()) def log_message(self, *args): pass HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', 18092), Handler).serve_forever() SCRIPT # Запустить в фоне nohup python3 /tmp/run_dashboard.py > /tmp/dashboard.log 2>&1 & sleep 1 ps aux | grep 'run_dashboard' | grep -v grep echo OK
